fullPassage: A recent study from Carnegie Mellon University in Pittsburgh, called "When Too Much of a Good Thing May Be Bad," indicates that classrooms with too much decoration are a source of distraction for young children and directly affect their cognitive performance. Being visually overstimulated, the children have a great deal of difficulty concentrating and end up with worse academic results. On the other hand, if there is not much decoration on the classroom walls, the children are less distracted, spend more time on their activities, and learn more. So it's our job, in order to support their attention, to find the right balance between excessive decoration and the complete absence of it.

det.tip: 명사 → 형용사: cognition → cognitive

questions.passage: A recent study from Carnegie Mellon University in Pittsburgh, called "When Too Much of a Good Thing May Be Bad," indicates that classrooms with too much decoration are a source of distraction for young children and directly affect their cognitive performance. Being visually overstimulated, __________ concentrating and end up with worse academic results. On the other hand, if there is not much decoration on the classroom walls, the children are less distracted, spend more time on their activities, and learn more. So it's our job, in order to support their attention, to find the right balance between excessive decoration and the complete absence of it.

아이들은 많은 어려움을 겪는다

[조건] (1) a, children, deal, difficulty, great, have, of, the를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: the children have a great deal of difficulty
det.analysis:
본문: 'the children have a great deal of difficulty concentrating' — a great deal of = 많은. have difficulty = 어려움을 겪다.

[조건 검증] the(1) children(2) have(3) a(4) great(5) deal(6) of(7) difficulty(8) = 8단어 ✅
det.tip: a great deal of + 불가산명사 = 많은 / have difficulty = 어려움을 겪다
